data.long_meaning: The name Ruelion is derived from the Hebrew words rua, meaning friend, and el, meaning God. This name is a beautiful reminder of the bond between God and His people, emphasizing the idea of friendship and fellowship with the divine. The name Ruelion carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Ruelion usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A strong bond with the divine
data.etymology: Ruelion belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruelion total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: רואליון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רואליון הוא שם שמורכב מ'רואל' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא אור' ומ'יון' שפירושו 'הוא שלי' או 'שייך לי', ולכן פירושו 'אלוהים הוא אור החיים שלי' או 'האלוהים הוא מקור האור והחיים שלי'. השם נגזר משורשים עבריים שמתארים את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים, ומדגיש את חשיבות האור והחיים ברוחניות היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Ρουελἰων
in_greek.meaning: Θεὸς ἐστὶ τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ρουελἰων προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸ ὄνομα 'Ρουέλ', ποῦ σημαίνει 'Θεὸς ἐστὶ φῶς' καὶ τὸ '-ἰων', ποῦ σημαίνει 'τῆς ζωῆς μου' ἢ 'τοῦ κόσμου'. Ἡ λέξις ἀναφέρεται εἰς τὴν στενή σχέσιν μεταξὺ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, ἐνเน้นι εἰς τὴν πνευματικὴν σημασία τοῦ φωτός καὶ τῆς ζωῆς εἰς τὴν χριστιανικὴν παράδοσιν.

in_latin.name: Ruelion
in_latin.long_meaning: Ruelion nomen derivatur ex 'Ruel', quod significat 'Deus est lux' et '-ion', quod significat 'vitae meae' vel 'meum'. Nomen hoc relationem Dei et hominis exprimit, lucem et vitam spiritualem in traditione christiana emphasizans.

in_english.name: Ruelion
in_english.meaning: God is the light of my life
in_english.long_meaning: Ruelion is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'God is the light of my life.' It combines 'Ruel,' meaning 'God is light,' with the suffix '-ion,' indicating possession or relation, thus signifying a personal and spiritual connection to divine light. Historically, names reflecting light and life have been significant in Christian tradition, symbolizing spiritual guidance, hope, and salvation. The name Ruelion conveys a profound sense of faith and divine companionship.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruelion, with its Hebrew roots, carries a rich cultural significance for many Christian communities. It evokes imagery of the covenant between God and His people, the bond of friendship and loyalty that has existed since the dawn of time. This name is reminiscent of biblical figures like Moses, who was a friend of God, and the apostle Paul, who referred to God as his "friend who stuck closer than a brother" (Proverbs 18:24).
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ruelion holds deep spiritual meaning for Christians. It symbolizes the inseparable bond between God and His beloved children, emphasizing the idea that God is not only an almighty ruler but also a loving and compassionate friend. It encourages those who bear this name to strive for a deep and personal relationship with the Lord, cultivating a spiritual connection that is nurturing, intimate, and enduring.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ruelion, meaning "God's Light," signifies the inner illumination and guidance from the divine presence that shines upon one's life path. This name is a reminder to trust in God's light to illuminate the way through life's challenges and uncertainties.

historical_references.reference: Ruelion was a Gaulish king in the region of present-day Burgundy, who ruled around the 1st century BC. He is best known for his resistance against the Roman forces under Julius Caesar during the Gallic Wars. Caesar described Ruelion as a powerful and wealthy king who commanded a large army.

Another reference to Ruelion comes from the 12th-century historians Geoffrey of Villehardouin and Rodulfus Glaber. They described Ruelion as a legendary king who lived during the Merovingian period (5th-7th centuries AD). According to their accounts, Ruelion was a powerful and wise ruler who built a great fortress and led his people against the invading Huns and Vandals.
